title: Boolean functions with equal numerical and algebraic degree
summary: Classify all Boolean functions whose integer numerical-normal-form degree equals their algebraic-normal-form degree over the binary field.

formal_statement.body: For every positive integer $n$ and Boolean function $f:\mathbb F_2^n\to\mathbb F_2$, let $d_{\mathrm{num}}(f)$ be the degree of the unique multilinear numerical normal form over $\mathbb Z$, and let $d_{\mathrm{alg}}(f)$ be the degree of the algebraic normal form over $\mathbb F_2$. Give necessary and sufficient conditions for $$d_{\mathrm{num}}(f)=d_{\mathrm{alg}}(f),$$ thereby classifying every equality case in every dimension.

scope.domain: Numerical and algebraic normal forms of Boolean functions
assumptions: $f:\mathbb F_2^n\to\mathbb F_2$ is an arbitrary Boolean function
$d_{\mathrm{num}}$ and $d_{\mathrm{alg}}$ use the source's NNF and ANF definitions
scope.unresolved_remainder: No inspected later work gives necessary and sufficient conditions for equality for every Boolean function and every dimension.

progress.summary: The source notes that numerical degree always bounds algebraic degree from below and asks for a complete classification of the equality cases.
